site.title: Pemberton Family Law
site.description: Divorce, custody and adoption counsel from two offices.
site.markdown:
# Pemberton Family Law

Divorce, custody, support and adoption counsel. Six attorneys, two offices, one standard: you always know where your matter stands.

## New clients

Email our office and we will send you our intake questionnaire as a PDF. Print it, fill it in and bring it to your first meeting, or scan it and send it back.

## Your engagement letter

After the first meeting we send an engagement letter. Please print, sign and return it by mail, by scan, or in person at either office.

## Offices

Downtown and Riverside, weekdays 8 to 5.

evidence: The New clients page says the intake questionnaire comes by email as a PDF, to print and fill in or scan back.
The engagement letter page asks clients to print, sign and return the letter by mail, scan or in person.

data.headline: Marlowe next to the shared drive, for Pemberton Family Law
data.intro: Your site names no intake tool. The New clients page sends a PDF by email and the engagement letter comes back on paper, so this page compares Marlowe with what that suggests you use today: shared drives and email. The drive is the better fit on one of the six rows, Marlowe on four, and one is a wash.
data.them_fit: Keep shared drives and email if your drive is tidy and nobody wants to learn a new tool. There is nothing to set up, and everyone already knows how it works.
data.us_fit: Marlowe is the better fit if the first hour on each new matter, the intake form, the engagement letter, the signature and the conflict check, is paralegal time you would rather have back across both offices.
